items.name: JoinSet
items.summary: A wrapper around [Tokio's `JoinSet`] that forwards all API calls while optionally instrumenting spawned tasks and blocking closures with custom tracing behavior. If no tracer is injected via [`set_join_set_tracer`], tasks and closures are…
